summary: Tianci International (Nasdaq: CIIT) filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026 disclosing a September 11, 2026 non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with BTC Digital Ltd. (Nasdaq: BTCT) to cooperate on a crypto computing project targeting roughly 3 MW of electrical load deployment within twelve months, succeeding an October 14, 2025 original MOU. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. The MOU is expressly non-binding, so no deal certainty attaches; BTCT would supply sites, power, equipment, and operations support. Watch for a definitive agreement, financing, and Nasdaq dilution risk.
